section.rule: A glob match with a .git file is a worktree; a real directory without one is moved by mv.
A glob match that is already a symlink to its target is DONE.
apply walks worktrees before clones, so a clone's records are updated by git before the clone moves.

section.make: mirror of the real tree in Podman

section.rule: Never deletes, never prunes, never overwrites an existing target.
Never moves a path a live process or seat is using; a fresh holder snapshot is taken right before each move.
One apply per home at a time: a directory lock under the artifact store state.
A second apply on a migrated tree reports changed 0 and leaves the tree identical.
Same filesystem only: a move is a rename, so bytes are untouched; across filesystems it is a CONFLICT.

section.gate: make home-apply CONF= ONLY=one idle worktree; make home-check CONF= ONLY= that worktree
make home-apply CONF=; make home-apply again shows changed 0; make home-check CONF=
section.rollback: home-migrate.sh rollback CONF with ONLY=old path: drops our symlink, git worktree move or mv back, repair
